messages:
maria (People Ops): heads-up: vendor cutover next week will affect HSA pre-tax elections and our July escalator. need quick Qs for the comms. who owns recon?
maria (People Ops): also, can employees opt out of the July auto-escalator after the cutover if they changed elections during migration?
tom (Payroll): payroll owns the final reconciliation with benefits vendor. opt-outs must be in the benefits portal before payroll cutoff for the pay period that includes the escalator date. cutover doesn't change policy but it can delay the feed.

olga (BenefitsVendor): confirming: our import will process the last export received before the maintenance window. any changes made directly in payroll during migration will need a delta file from payroll. we can accept deltas up to 7 business days after the first affected payroll.
jade (IC): i'm on leave in July and missed the portal window previously. what should I do if the cutoff passes?
tom (Payroll): if cutoff passes, we can do a manual adjustment pre-payroll posting. after pay posts, reversals are possible but taxes may need correction; we prefer to avoid that. contact payroll ASAP and include dated proof of the intended election.
maria (People Ops): draft comms bullets for managers/employees: 1) Opt-out must be toggled in Benefits portal before payroll cutoff on 2024-06-28. 2) If you updated elections in payroll during the vendor cutover, email payroll@redwood.com with screenshots and cc benefits@redwood.com by 2024-07-05 for reconciliation. 3) If you're on leave and missed cutoff, contact People Ops immediately; we will try to assist but can't guarantee tax-neutral corrections.

olga (BenefitsVendor): vendor action: we'll run a pre-cutover validation and send a flagged list to payroll on 2024-06-26. payroll should review and return confirmations by 2024-06-27 COB to make the cutover export clean.
tom (Payroll): i'll enable an auto-reply on payroll@ with the deadlines and sync with the migration team.

hr-bot: Internal guide: https://internal.redwood.com/hr/benefits/migration-checklist (link)
maria (People Ops): thanks team — i'll send the employee comms tomorrow morning with the how-to snippet and deadlines. :email:
